resumeText:
LENA VOSS (fictional sample)
Berlin, Germany · lena.voss@example.com

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 7 years building data-heavy web services.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer — Kestrel Logistics GmbH, Berlin — 03/2022 to present
- Led migration of the shipment-tracking API from a Python monolith to TypeScript services; p95 latency fell from 900 ms to 180 ms.
- Designed the PostgreSQL partitioning scheme for 2 billion tracking events.
- Mentored 4 engineers; ran the team's hiring loop for 2 years.

Software Engineer — Pixelgrove Studios, Hamburg — 06/2018 to 02/2022
- Built the billing service in Node.js handling 30k invoices a month.
- Introduced end-to-end tests that cut production incidents by 40%.

Junior Developer — Pixelgrove Studios, Hamburg — 09/2017 to 05/2018
- Maintained internal admin tools (PHP, MySQL).

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science — University of Hamburg — 2017

SKILLS
TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, AWS (ECS, RDS), Docker, Terraform
LANGUAGES: German (native), English (fluent)
